prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dynamic, off-kilter close-up of a man with curly, disheveled dark hair, captured in motion as if he is falling or stumbling backward. His face is out of focus, conveying a sense of disorientation and urgency, while his expression appears startled or distressed. He wears period clothing, including a dark blue coat and a cream-colored cravat, suggesting a historical or 19th-century setting. The background features the exterior of a brick building with white-trimmed windows, partially blurred due to the shallow depth of field and the motion blur effect. A piece of light-colored fabric or paper flutters from an upper window, adding to the chaotic atmosphere. The color palette is muted and natural, dominated by earthy browns, off-whites, and deep blues. The lighting is soft and diffuse, evoking an overcast day. The camera angle is tilted and low, looking up at the subject, enhancing the sense of instability and cinematic drama. The overall style is reminiscent of a period film with a handheld, immersive quality, emphasizing immediacy and emotional intensity.
